description: A shell script implementing access control policies for Git hooks/update, including branch/tag policies and user/group permissions.

methods.name: grant
methods.description: Outputs 'grant' and exits with success, granting access.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Outputs 'deny' and exits with failure, denying access.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs informational messages if verbose mode is enabled.
